_readme: EXAMPLE ONLY — fictional, defect-free, and safe to publish. The real seeded-error definitions are the facilitator's and MUST NOT live in this repository: semantic defects written in plain language are legible to anyone who reads the file, so committing them would train every participant who browses the repo. Keep the real definitions facilitator-held outside the repository and provide them only at run time: SampleGenerator <repoRoot> <outDir> --seeded <definitions.json>. This example exists to document the shape and to keep the loader under test.
